contract: A C++20 program for AtCoder heuristic contest ahc046 (EVOLVE-BLOCK markers optional); scored by ALE-Bench on 50 public cases, score sign-adjusted so higher is better
notes: ALE-Bench compiles its Rust judge tools in a rust:1.79.0-buster container at every session and runs candidates in the ale-bench:cpp20-202301 judge image (both must be the same CPU architecture: on Apple silicon pull the Rust image with --platform linux/amd64 because the judge images are amd64). On macOS run with TMPDIR under $HOME so the Docker VM can mount the build directory.
protocol_description: Verbatim EvoX ALE-Bench evaluator (skydiscover benchmarks) with a shim for its unpublished session helper; the judge is the public ALE-Bench package.
name: ahc046 Skating with blocks
limitations: Appendix task prose conflicts with standard circle-packing/Heilbronn definitions; the pinned evaluator is authoritative. Telemetry-repair directory is not present at inspected commit.
Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.
